text.en:
Section Four of Presidential Decree No. 604 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 4. Department Proper. The Department shall have an Administrative, Finance and Planning Office, and
Programs and Operations Office. Each Office shall be headed by an Assistant Secretary, who shall be
appointed by the President. The Assistant Secretary for Administration, Finance and Planning shall be assisted
by a Director and Assistant Director for Administration and a Director and Assistant Director for Finance and
a Director and Assistant Director for Planning. The Assistant Secretary for Programs and Operations shall be
assisted by a Director and Assistant Director for Programs and Operations. Considering the nature of the
functions of the Department, positions of Project Directors may be created subject to approval by the
President. All their salaries shall be consistent and in accordance with the approved budgetary and
organizational structure of the Department.
The Department Proper shall provide specialized knowledge and consultancy services at the regional level in
the execution of sports programs, as well as establish the necessary linkages and coordination with the
Philippine Olympic Committee, National Sports Council and the Inter-Agency Services Committee created
under Letter of Instructions No. 662 dated 25 January 1978, and such other agencies of the government and
private institutions which the Department Secretary or Undersecretary shall deem necessary in the promotion
of the objectives of the Decree.
The Administrative Office shall, among others, be responsible for providing the Department with economical,
efficient and effective services relating to personnel, legal, supplies, procurement thereof, information, records
and custodial works, security and other general services.

The Finance Office shall, among others, be responsible for providing the Department with efficient and
effective services on the budgetary requirements, accounting and auditing of expenditures, and such other
staff assistance and advice on financial and budgetary matters.
The Planning Office shall, among others, be responsible for providing the Department with economical,
efficient and effective services on drawing up plants and programs, policy formulation, analysis and
coordination, project evaluation, research development and regional monitoring.
The Program and Operations Office shall, among others, be responsible for providing the Department with
economical, efficient and effective services on the implementation and execution of approved plants and
specialized projects including the drawing of the necessary detailed program of work, program development
and improvement, coordination of regional activities, and the monitoring of implementation and
performance."

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Decree is declared unconstitutional, the same shall
apply only to the provision and the remainder hereof remains valid.

Repealing Clause. All laws, decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations which are
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
